solves.reason: 선택받는 첫 노트북은 리뷰 많고(many) 평점 높으며(high) 가장 만족한(satisfied) 고객 보유
solves.reasoning: The first has [many] reviews / a [high] rating / most [satisfied] customers → many-high-satisfied

solves.reason: 구매를 결정(decide)하려 하고 만족 고객 많은 것을 고름(select), 결정 못한(undecided) 쇼핑객이 흔들림
solves.reasoning: trying to [decide] which to purchase / will [select] the one / [undecided] shoppers are swayed → decide-select-undecided

solves.reason: 제3자 영향력을 빌리고(borrow) 신규 고객을 유혹(luring)하며 리뷰 남기게 간절히(eager) 설득
solves.reasoning: [borrow] third-party influence / [luring] new customers / so [eager] to persuade → borrow-luring-eager

solves.reason: ④ worthless selling point 부적절 — 사회적 증거는 귀중한(invaluable) 판매 포인트여야 함
solves.reasoning: social proof is an invaluable selling point, so ④ worthless는 문맥상 반대 → 정답 ④

solves.reason: ① dissatisfied customers 부적절 — 가장 만족한(satisfied) 고객을 고른다는 흐름
solves.reasoning: you select the one with the most satisfied customers, so ① dissatisfied는 반대 → 정답 ①

solves.reason: ② lend third-party influence 부적절 — 마케터는 영향력을 빌려(borrow) 옴
solves.reasoning: marketers borrow third-party influence, so ② lend는 반대 방향 → 정답 ②

solves.reason: 가장 만족한 고객을 가진 상품을 '고르게(select)' 됨
solves.reasoning: you will ___ the one with the most satisfied customers → select; avoid/ignore/delete는 문맥 반대·무관

solves.reason: strive to ___ to social norms → 사회 규범을 '따르다(conform)'
solves.reasoning: conform to social norms 연어; object(반대)·appeal·respond는 부적합 → conform

solves.reason: borrow third-party ___ → 제3자의 '영향력(influence)'
solves.reasoning: borrow third-party influence 연어; payment·warning·obstacle은 문맥 무관 → influence

solves.reason: purchase(구매하다) ≈ buy(사다)
solves.reasoning: purchase = 사다; sell(반대)·borrow·return과 구별 → buy

solves.reason: luring(유혹하는) ≈ attracting(끌어들이는)
solves.reasoning: luring new customers = 끌어들이다; rejecting(반대)·warning·ignoring 제외 → attracting

solves.reason: eager(간절한) ≈ keen(열심인)
solves.reasoning: so eager to persuade = 열심인; reluctant(반대)·tired·afraid 제외 → keen

solves.reason: undecided(결정 못한) ↔ resolute(단호한); hesitant는 동의 함정
solves.reasoning: undecided의 반대는 단호함 → resolute; hesitant는 유의어, curious/anxious는 다른 축

solves.reason: invaluable(매우 귀중한) ↔ worthless(가치 없는); precious는 동의 함정
solves.reasoning: invaluable의 반대는 가치 없음 → worthless; precious는 유의어, harmful/scarce는 다른 축

solves.reason: (A) leave reviews=남기다, (B) leave the meeting=떠나다
solves.reasoning: (A) leave honest reviews=남기다 / (B) leave the meeting early=떠나다 → 남기다-떠나다

solves.reason: 이유를 들어 하도록 동의하게 만들다 → persuade(설득하다)
solves.reasoning: make someone agree by giving good reasons = 설득 → persuade; purchase·consider·conform 제외

solves.reason: are easily ___ (sway) → be동사+과거분사 수동태 → swayed
solves.reasoning: Shoppers are easily ___ (sway) by reviews → 주어가 흔들림을 당함(수동) → be+p.p. → swayed

solves.reason: in the interest of ___ (lure) → 전치사 of + 동명사 → luring
solves.reasoning: in the interest of ___ (lure) → 전치사 of 뒤 동명사 자리 → luring

solves.reason: 리뷰 많고 평점 높은 상품 = 가장 만족한 고객을 가진 상품
solves.reasoning: select the one with ___ ; 첫 노트북=many reviews+high rating이 선택 대상 → the most satisfied customers

solves.reason: social proof는 사람들이 사회 규범에 따르려 한다는 생각 근거
solves.reasoning: social proof=people strive to ___ ; 뒤에 conform to social norms 논지 → conform to social norms
